name: Teams
overview: Scripture reveals that God designed human beings for partnership and unity, as seen in His creation of a suitable helper for man (Genesis 2:18) and the blessing of brethren dwelling together in harmony (Psalms 133:1). The wisdom of collective counsel and mutual encouragement is emphasized, with safety found in many advisers (Proverbs 11:14) and the sharpening of one another through close relationships (Proverbs 27:17). Additionally, teamwork yields greater fruitfulness and reward (Ecclesiastes 4:9), and believers are called to be of one mind, reflecting the unity exemplified in Christ (Romans 15:5).
